title: skills-sh-jezweb-claude-skills-claude-agent-sdk
summary: # Changelog ## 0.3.323 - Added `machinePolicy.didNotLoad` (alpha) to `resolveSettings()`'s result, which tells a host when a machine policy source may be there and did not load - Added `matchDeniedModels()` (alpha), which tells a host which models a `deniedModels` list blocks, by Claude Code's own entry rules - Added the periodic `tool_progress` heartbeat while a turn waits on long-running hooks; `tool_name` is the hook event, `tool_use_id` begins `hook-`, `parent_tool_use_id` may name no tool call - Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AGENT_PROGRESS_SUMMARIES`: set to `1` to turn off subagent progress summaries even when `agentProgressSummaries` is `true` (available since 0.3.318) - Added `tool_use_result` to a subagent's WebSearch result message when the search did not run or found nothing - Fixed progress notifications from SDK MCP servers being dropped for tool calls that were still running when the set of SDK MCP servers changed - Fixed `resolveSettings()` keeping its first reading of a macOS MDM profile or Windows registry policy for the life of the process: it now re-reads after 30 minutes, and sooner after a read that failed - Fixed `forkSession()` with `upToMessageId`: forking at a compaction summary no longer brings back the messages kept after it, and forking at a compaction boundary keeps the conversation before it
type: skills
tags: skills-sh, skills-sh-all-time
source_url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/claude-agent-sdk-typescript/main/CHANGELOG.md
